value.rationale: Sharp fixed-vertex sensor cardinality is a natural inverse graph diffusion question: largest eigenspace forces eight sensors, yet arbitrary eigenspace coordinates do not imply any eight physical vertices suffice. The explicit connected rectangle solves this constrained design problem uniformly for all p>=5 and yields constructive all-signal reconstruction without bandlimiting. It is not a minor numerical optimization or arbitrary slice.
